evidenceIndex.decode: For each command column named in dictionaries, replace its integer cell with that dictionary entry. Other cells (including null) stay exact. taskId is the enclosing taskId. Recreate commandSummary from executable/argumentCount/argvSha256. Derive receipt.json/stdout.txt/stderr.txt indices as root + commands/runId/commandId/filename, with the corresponding Sha256/SizeBytes cells. Add originalRows. Canonical verification uses UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys, no spaces, Unicode preserved. No number or timestamp rounding. The timingStatus and receipt hash/length columns are explicitly derived as defined in derivedColumns; they are not asserted to exist as original receipt fields.
evidenceIndex.scope: All actual task command receipts after the immutable baseline commit through selectionEndUtc, plus every qualified-prefix command; later delivery commands are recorded outside the content commit. Historical baseline is exactly one immutable Git layer.

derivedColumns.timingStatus: Derived, not an original receipt field: WITHIN_REGISTERED_COMMAND_DEADLINE iff original elapsedSeconds <= original deadlineSeconds; otherwise EXCEEDED_REGISTERED_COMMAND_DEADLINE. This is only the registered command deadline, not a product/source/cleanup/stage budget or exit-code PASS.
derivedColumns.commandSummaryProjection: executable/argumentCount/argvSha256 preserve commandSummary executable/argumentCount/sha256 exactly; original cwd and raw streams are private and indexed by SHA/size, not published

canonicalHashes.expandedRowsSha256: SHA256 of the decoded TWO-DIMENSIONAL ARRAY in the declared columns order and stored rows order, not an array of objects. Encode UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, separators=(comma,colon), sort_keys=true; no trailing newline.
canonicalHashes.expandedOriginalIndexSha256: Derive command file indices using RELATIVE paths commands/<runId>/<commandId>/<filename>; combine with originalRows as objects {path,sha256,sizeBytes}. Sort objects by relative path, then encode with the same canonical JSON rule. Do NOT prepend root for this hash. Prepend root only when opening files.
